description: AI-generate and save a quiz from a topic. Prefer providing themeDescription or themeCustomization; when omitted, the server derives and saves a topic-based custom theme. Omit backgroundMusicId to use default YouTube-safe shared background music, or set null for silent. The response `data` always includes a `watchUrl` (the public quiz-viewer page, instantly playable). When autoRender is true, `data.render` also contains the queued render session so the agent can poll quiz_video_get_render for the MP4.

answerOptionCount.description: For multiple-choice quizzes, generate 3 or 4 answer options per question. Defaults to 4.

autoRender.description: If true, immediately queue a video render for the new quiz. The render session (sessionId, status) is returned under `data.render`; poll quiz_video_get_render with that sessionId for progress and the final videoUrl. Rendering typically takes 1-5 minutes. Quiz creation is not blocked by render-queue failures — the quiz is returned either way.

backgroundMusicId.description: Background music track id from /api/v1/music. Omit to use the default YouTube-safe shared track; set null for silent.

countdownSeconds.description: Seconds of countdown shown before each question (3-15).

extraDirection.description: Additional instructions to steer the AI (tone, focus areas, exclusions). Up to 20,000 characters.

musicVolume.description: Background music volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Default 0.15.

template.description: Visual template id. If omitted, the saved custom theme can suggest a matching template.

themeCustomization.description: Explicit custom theme to save and apply to the generated quiz. Use themeDescription for prompt-style themes.

description.description: Optional natural-language source description for the custom theme.

fontFamilyOverride.description: Approved font family used for question and answer text.

name.description: Optional saved theme label, e.g. "Golden Theme".

themeDescription.description: Natural-language custom visual theme prompt. Example: "golden luxury game show", "ocean glass", or "cyber neon".

topic.description: Subject the AI should build the quiz around. Can be a short topic or a detailed multi-paragraph brief (up to 20,000 characters).

name: quiz_video_generate_quiz
title: Generate a quiz with AI
